title: Blender camera lock plus Seedance 2.5 skin via Higgsfield plugin
summary: Abyssal workflow builds a low-poly car scene in Blender with Higgsfield plugin, locks the camera path, then Seedance 2.5 skins the previz using location and character photo refs without inventing new shots.
question_it_answers: How do you use Blender previz and Seedance 2.5 to lock camera path before video generation?

claims.text: 3D scene and exact camera path are built and locked in Blender before Seedance generation.
claims.evidence:
The 3D scene was built first.
Then the camera was locked inside Blender.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

claims.text: Seedance follows the Blender camera move with refs for location, characters, and car while prompt forbids new shots or swapped seats.
claims.evidence:
Seedance follows the Blender move. 
Same angles. Same timing. Same path.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

media.description: About thirty-second demo of a night driving scene where Blender-locked camera path is skinned by Seedance 2.5 with photo references.
